description: Creates a VCI workspace (a folder on the serve host that mirrors project objects as files) or reuses it: the same name with the same root answers status reused with the EXISTING workspace's root and writes nothing to TIA. It always creates in the system group, and the serve creates the root folder when it is missing (createdDirectory). rootPath must be an absolute local drive path such as C:\TIA\_scratch\ws; a UNC, device or relative path, a . or .. segment or a reserved name is 400 invalid_workspace_path. Refusals, each with nothing changed: 409 workspace_exists (the name exists, in any group, with a DIFFERENT root: details.name, existingRoot, requestedRoot), 409 workspace_root_in_use (another workspace of any group already uses that root: details.root, workspace) and 409 vci_unavailable. A 504 worker_restarted, a timeout or a lost connection has an UNKNOWN outcome: list the workspaces before repeating. Run it with dryRun:true first (Gd11): the serve answers with the plan (action create or reuse, willCreateDirectory) or the same refusal WITHOUT creating anything. Requires a connected project; 409 vci_inventory_incomplete (the workspace inventory could not be read completely): the name and root cannot then be checked against every group, nothing changed. Maps to POST /vci/workspaces {name, rootPath, dryRun?}. Class M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

name.description: workspace name (at most 128 characters, none of < > : " / \ | ? *)

rootPath.description: absolute local drive path of the root folder on the serve host, for example C:\TIA\_scratch\ws

name: tia_vci_workspace_create
title: TIA — create a VCI workspace
